name: Catalog sync · semantic API optimization

trials.rationale: Deduplicate category and FX keys within each (tenant, snapshot), then partition each kind into batches of at most batch_size. Each batch uses one shared api() task, shielded from cancellation by individual jobs. This minimizes logical enrichment requests to the sum of ceil(unique keys / batch_size) across scopes and kinds. Each product retains its own inventory read, exact transform, receipt order, and stable write key. Transport initialization, admit(), and api() are preserved.

scope: Authored local catalog workload. Snapshot-safe shared lookups and declared bulk API. Real HTTP; synthetic provider.
